sampling: One identical precomputed schedule for both arms, drawn with replacement proportional to declared training pair weights. Minibatch loss is unweighted; do not apply weights twice.
reference_cache: All unique training-pair genotypes, once per initial checkpoint. No development or test genotype is included in these reference caches.
scope: Two bounded single-seed development pilots. Equal DPO update and sequence-exposure budgets; SFT-to-DPO also includes its preceding SFT compute. Fixed final-step reporting, no checkpoint selection or test evaluation.
